name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: Terrain-aware wintry forecast using ECMWF vertical profiles and Windy local terrain. Shows adaptive snowline contours, terrain temperature and humidity, precipitation type including convective-snow potential, estimated new snow, a 144-hour graph, and forecast soundings.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
